CustomField.description: CIBGLOBALD-4117: semicolon-joined list of DMT_Items__c.DMT_Component_Item__c values that were actually configured for this task's approver view at freeze time (e.g. "Line Info;Client;Approval Process Data"). Lets the restart watch gate (DMT_ApprovalChangeStep_Helper.isTaskStale) scope its field comparison to only the components that could actually have been frozen for this specific task, instead of blindly checking every renderer-tracked component regardless of whether it was ever part of this view. Blank on older snapshots predating this field - the watch gate falls back to the unscoped check in that case.
CustomField.label: Tracked Components
